{"concepts_used":["GC-0121","GC-0044"],"decline_reason":"","declined":false,"citations":[{"ref":"TMM/Part14/x-annex-a5---using-the-trade-marks-classification-search/searching-for-goods-and-services","quote":"The Trade Marks Classification Search is available to examiners via RIO Dashboard > Register Search, under the heading ‘Classification search’ accessible from the drop-down menu in the top right corner of the screen."},{"ref":"TMM/Part14/x-annex-a5---using-the-trade-marks-classification-search/searching-for-goods-and-services","quote":"For external users, the Trade Marks Classification Search is also available from the Advanced Search screen of the Australian Trade Mark Search."}],"answer":"According to the Manual (practice), Annex A5:

- **Examiners:** go to **RIO Dashboard > Register Search**, then open the drop-down menu in the top-right corner of the screen and select **‘Classification search’**. [citation 1]
- **External users:** access the Trade Marks Classification Search from the **Advanced Search** screen of **Australian Trade Mark Search**. [citation 2]

These access instructions are Manual practice, not requirements of the Act or Regulations."}
